description:
User requested stronger submission lineage after reviewing documents and commercial_capacity_entries. Backend-only integrity slice supporting AIN-108 and AIN-95; no UI workflow change.
Acceptance: preserve separate domain tables and all existing records; add an explicit database-enforced submission association for generic documents whose entityType is submission, preserving other attachment types and null-owner semantics. Add a typed foreign key from reinsurance capacity entries to their immutable placement, providing exact submission ID and source snapshot hash via a documented database view. Validate tenant/party and target-entry lineage; reject missing, contradictory and malformed references. Backfill only deterministic references and abort atomically on unresolved legacy mappings; never assign today's revision to old evidence. Retain external/non-submission capacity references explicitly. Verify valid legacy migration, invalid direct writes, immutability, retry/concurrency and existing reinsurance reservation/binding flows in disposable PostgreSQL. Run EnsuredAPI format and check. Document compatibility/application rollback and migration status. Local implementation and verification only; no production rollout.
Required order: AIN-48 ownership contract slice, AIN-49 reference constraints, AIN-54 additive migration/reconciliation slice. Reuse AIN-205 versioned ownership. Broader AIN-18 stale-dependency propagation and AIN-50 flexible schemas remain unchanged; financial settlement, UI regeneration, billing and party workflows are excluded because they are not required for these links. Parent AIN-47 and stories remain open until their broader criteria are met.
